content: <rss version="2.0"><channel><title>ESPN NBA</title><link>https://www.espn.com/</link><description>ESPN public league news</description><item><title>Miami Heat unveil 'A Night in Vice City' jerseys ahead of GTA VI release</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50085674/miami-heat-night-vice-city-game</link><description>With Grand Theft Auto VI's long-awaited release date set for Nov. 19, the Heat are partnering with Rockstar Games to offer a topical lead-up event the night before.</description><pubDate>Fri, 06 Nov 2026 16:52:03 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1002/r1725012_608x342_16-9.jpg" /></item><item><title>Stephen A. reacts to Doc Rivers saying Giannis is 'not easy' to coach</title><link>https://www.espn.com/video/clip/_/id/50399783/stephen-reacts-doc-rivers-saying-giannis-not-easy-coach</link><description>Stephen A. reacts to Doc Rivers saying Giannis is 'not easy' to coach</description><pubDate>Fri, 06 Nov 2026 15:44:51 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://espnmedia-cdn.akamaized.net/espn/media/common/2026/1106/ss_20261106_103611947_3727589643/ss_20261106_103611947_3727589643.jpg" /></item><item><title>Stephen A. says the championship window is STILL OPEN for Steph Curry & the Warriors</title><link>https://www.espn.com/video/clip/_/id/50399737/stephen-says-championship-window-open-steph-curry-warriors</link><description>On First Take, Stephen A. Smith, Gerald McCoy and Cam'ron join Shae Cornette to share thoughts on the Golden State Warriors, along with Doc Rivers making comments about Giannis Antetokounmpo.</description><pubDate>Fri, 06 Nov 2026 16:49:32 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://espnmedia-cdn.akamaized.net/espn/media/common/2026/1106/ss_20261106_103030181_3727586706/ss_20261106_103030181_3727586706.jpg" /></item><item><title>LeBron James vs. Cleveland: Top performances against Cavaliers</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/42078248/lebron-james-notable-games-opponent-cleveland</link><description>James holds a 9-4 record with averages of 29.6 points, 8.5 rebounds and 6.9 assists per game on 54% shooting in Cleveland as an opponent.</description><pubDate>Fri, 06 Nov 2026 14:44:12 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2024/1029/r1407704_608x342_16-9.jpg" /></item><item><title>Doc Rivers: Giannis 'didn't want to be the bad guy' when seeking Bucks exit</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50399276/doc-rivers-giannis-antetokounmpo-bucks-exit-coaching-star</link><description>Former Bucks coach Doc Rivers said Giannis Antetokounmpo "didn't want to be the bad guy" when he was trying to seek a trade out of Milwaukee last season.</description><pubDate>Fri, 06 Nov 2026 16:01:02 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2024/0906/r1382887_1296x729_16-9.jpg" /></item><item><title>Fantasy basketball's biggest surprise: What to make of Ty Jerome's hot start</title><link>https://www.espn.com/fantasy/basketball/story/_/id/50390769/fantasy-basketball-ty-jerome-surprises-scoring-breakout</link><description>Andre Snellings examines whether Ty Jerome is likely to keep up his tremendous start to the season.</description><pubDate>Fri, 06 Nov 2026 12:24:48 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1105/r1741726_1296x729_16-9.jpg" /></item></channel></rss>
